datasets.title: Ethiopia - Settlement catchment areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows settlement-based catchment areas in Ethiopia with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/ethiopia-settlement-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Settlement catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters using gridded population data, assigning representative points to each cluster, and applying Voronoi tessellation to delineate catchment boundaries. Population estimates from multiple sources (WorldPop, Kontur, Meta) were aggregated and disaggregated by sex and age within each catchment. Building counts and footprint areas were derived from OpenStreetMap and Google Buildings datasets at varying confidence levels.

sources.name: WorldPop
sources.description: Gridded population estimates for 2020 used to disaggregate population within settlement catchments

sources.name: Kontur
sources.description: High-resolution population distribution data (2023) integrated into settlement population estimates

sources.name: Meta
sources.description: Demographic data including sex and age disaggregation (2023) for population characterization

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Building footprint data (2024) used to derive building counts and average footprint areas

sources.name: Google Buildings
sources.description: High-confidence building detection data (2023) at multiple confidence thresholds for building inventory
